newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley suffers loss from options hedge.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley suffers loss from options hedge.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc said the firm suffered a loss in July related to an "imperfect" options hedge.
"The loss was not material and was related to a (options) hedge that became imperfect in a volatile market environment," a spokeswoman said.
She said an unidentified trader on the convertible bond desk suffered the loss, adding that the trader was still employed by Morgan. She declined to provide other details.
A Morgan source said the loss of $25 million related to a position in Office Depot Inc convertible bonds and a short position in Office Depot call options that was taken as a hedge.
Morgan reported on October 2 that third quarter results rose to $1.32 per primary share from $1.23 a year ago.
